h1: The wellness build that files your heart condition under plumbing questions

criteria.h1: The wellness build that files your heart condition under plumbing questions
tableRows: Easy AppointmentsDocumented self-hosted appointment plugin marketed for service businesses (plugin version 4.0.3). WordPress admin screens cover locations, services, workers, an appointments list, a customer list, custom form fields, and CSV export. A window such as "plumb week, screening note, shower photo" is a booking you create; a service name such as steam shower or steam unit is a label you configure. Neither is a documented default. Shower-photo, generator-note, medical-screening, fixture-size, property-address, owner-name, phone, email, or appointment-date questions are custom fields you add (textarea, select, input, checkbox, or file); they are not documented defaults. A booking is a calendar row, not proof of work - and a CSV export of "plumb week + screening note + shower photo" next to a named owner is still a calendar that answers when the crew is expected. Emails can include those custom fields and copy the appointment off-site. An optional GDPR setting can auto-remove customer data older than six months; that is not a default purge. Google Calendar, SMS, and payments are Pro. Google reCAPTCHA is optional. Public booking-form browser hosts are unverified. | Steam-shower installation service bookings stored on your WordPress site | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv4.0.3 readme.txt (SVN)

Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form BuilderDocumented self-hosted form builder (plugin version 1.58.1). The listing states Forminator stores and organizes submissions so you can sort, analyze, and manage responses, and includes a free file-upload field with multi-file support. Version 1.58.1 helper-fields.php forminator_upload_root() writes under the WordPress uploads directory plus /forminator/, with per-form hashed subfolders from forminator_get_upload_path(). upload.php stores files through that path. Shower-photo, generator-note, medical-screening, fixture-size, property-address, owner-name, phone, email, or appointment-date questions are fields you add; they are not documented defaults. Optional shower stall photo uploads are files you accept; that file type is not a documented default. A shower photo is a stored file, not a humidity survey. A heart-condition note is stored text, not a medical record. A steam-shower form is not proof anyone plumbed a unit. Notification emails can copy field values and file links off-site. Optional Stripe, PayPal, HubSpot, Mailchimp, and webhook integrations send data only when you enable them. Public form-page browser hosts are unverified. How long a shower stall photo sits after a call that never happened is not a documented default of the plugin. | Screening and fixture answers stored in WordPress; optional shower-photo uploads in the site uploads/forminator folder | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv1.58.1 readme.txt (SVN)v1.58.1 helper-fields.php (upload root)v1.58.1 upload.php

Iptanus File UploadDocumented frontend upload form (formerly WordPress File Upload). By default files land inside the wp-content directory of the site; the upload path is configurable. Uploaded files can be added to Media or attached to the current page. FTP and SFTP destinations are documented. The Professional version documents uploads to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, or Amazon S3. A shower photo or fixture-plan PDF is a file you accept; that file type is not a documented default. An uploaded shower photo is a stored file, not a humidity survey. Deleting a form entry later does not by itself prove the file was removed from the uploads path or from a cloud destination you enabled. The listing claims GDPR compliance without a tested EXIF-strip or retention length here. Review upload directory, Media attachment, and cloud destinations. Browser hosts for the visitor upload path were not verified for this snapshot. How long a shower stall photo file sits after a call that never happened is not a documented default of the plugin. | Shower-photo and fixture-plan uploads stored under the site wp-content path | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listing
